abertura: Take a pig and give it a bath. The moment you're done, it'll run straight back into the mud.
transcricao: Take a pig and give it a bath. The moment you're done, it'll run straight back into the mud. Not because it can't change, but because that's its nature. Now take a snake, care for it, feed it, and sleep beside it every night. The first chance it gets while you're asleep, it'll bite you. You can't change people even when you believe they'd never betray you. Because everyone has their own nature. Judah betrayed the very God that he believed was the Messiah. Understand that in life, you can never trust people 100%. Every human being ultimately looks out for themselves. Even if you've completely changed their lives, it's better to accept people's nature than to be disappointed when they won't change the way you want them to change. Welcome to The Undercise.

abertura: Some of the most brutal quotes from the greatest minds in history. I don't care that they sold my idea, but I care is that they don't have any of their own.
transcricao: Some of the most brutal quotes from the greatest minds in history. I don't care that they sold my idea, but I care is that they don't have any of their own. Nikola Tesla. Intelligence is the ability to adapt to change. Stephen Hawking. Before you diagnose someone with depression, make sure they aren't simply surrounded by idiots. Sigmund Freud. Little knowledge makes people feel proud. A lot of knowledge makes them feel humble. Leonardo da Vinci. No great discovery was ever made without a bold guess. Isaac Newton. Truth will always remain truth, even if everyone rejects it and contradicts it. Galileo Galilei. We cannot solve our problems with the same thinking we used when we created them. Albert Einstein. A person who dares to waste one hour of their time has not discovered the value of life. Charles Darwin. Welcome to the other side.

abertura: If you ever notice these seven signs in someone, don't ignore them. If someone stays up late at night, they might be overthinking things that have hurt them in the past.
transcricao: If you ever notice these seven signs in someone, don't ignore them. If someone stays up late at night, they might be overthinking things that have hurt them in the past. If someone stays quiet when they're getting criticized, they've probably seen themselves break down so many times that other people's words don't hurt them that much anymore. If someone gets attached to people quickly, it doesn't mean they're necessarily looking for love. They might be looking for a feeling they've never experienced before. If someone cares more about others than they care about themselves, maybe it's because they've always needed the same care and never received it. If someone apologizes too quickly, they might have grown up being taught that their feelings were always wrong. If someone handles everything on their own, maybe they've been let down so many times that they stopped trusting people. And if someone's always making other people laugh, they might be hiding just how lonely they feel inside. Now you know what they might be missing. Give them the things they may have never received. Welcome to the other side.

abertura: People will start chasing you when you learn these four psychological principles. 1. Work in silence.
transcricao: People will start chasing you when you learn these four psychological principles. 1. Work in silence. If someone talks to another person just to make you jealous, don't get angry. Just stay calm. 2. Stop giving them attention. Whoever wants to be around you will make an effort to come to you. Don't lower your value by chasing anyone. 3. Put yourself first. If you're busy, don't rush to reply to a text. Finish what you're doing first. That message can wait. 4. Never look back. When a relationship is over, move on as if that person was never a part of your life. Or at least learn a lesson from that. And if that made sense to you, welcome to the other side.

abertura: Body wants sex. Heart wants love.
transcricao: Body wants sex. Heart wants love. Soul wants peace. Mind wants success. Eyes wants sleep. Ego wants validation. Childhood wants healing. Life wants purpose. Loneliness wants company. Past wants closure. Every part of you wants something different. Somehow you're supposed to have it all figured out. Take it easy on yourself. Welcome to the other side.
